Office With The State-Of-The-Art Dental Technology

At Arvada Dental Center & Implants, we utilize the latest dental technology to provide efficient and effective treatments. Our modern equipment ensures accurate diagnoses and enhances your dental experience.

Digital X-Rays: Reduce radiation exposure and improve image clarity.

CAD/CAM Systems: Create precise crowns and restorations on-site.

Emergency Dentistry Services In Arvada

Dental emergencies can happen anytime, and quick action is essential to prevent further complications. At Arvada Dental Center & Implants, we’re prepared to handle your urgent dental needs with efficiency and care.

Same-Day Appointments: We prioritize emergency cases to provide prompt treatment.
Pain Management: Immediate solutions to alleviate discomfort.
Accident Care: Expert handling of dental injuries, including knocked-out teeth and fractures.
Infection Prevention: Quick interventions to avoid infections and other complications.
24/7 Availability: Accessible support outside regular hours for unexpected dental issues.

Our dedicated team ensures that you receive swift and effective care, minimizing pain and restoring your oral health as quickly as possible.

Family Dentistry Tailored To Your Needs

Your family’s dental health is our top priority. At Arvada Dental Center & Implants, we offer personalized dental services that cater to every member of your household.

Adult Dentistry: Comprehensive treatments to maintain and enhance your smile.
Senior Dentistry: Specialized services addressing age-related dental concerns.

Educational Support: Guidance on proper oral hygiene practices for all ages.

We create a welcoming environment where everyone—from toddlers to grandparents—feels comfortable and cared for, ensuring lasting dental health for your entire family.

Affordable Dental Care Options For Whole Family

Our goal is to remove financial barriers, ensuring you receive the necessary dental treatments to maintain a healthy and beautiful smile.

Patient-Centered Approach To Dental Health

Customized Treatment Plans: Tailored to fit your lifestyle and preferences.

Comfortable Environment: A relaxing atmosphere to ease any dental anxiety.
Holistic Care: Considering your overall health to provide comprehensive dental solutions.
Continuous Support: From your first visit to ongoing maintenance, we’re here for you.

Our patient-centered approach ensures that you receive the highest quality of care in a setting that prioritizes your well-being.

Convenient Location And Flexible Scheduling

Balancing dental appointments with your busy schedule is easy with Arvada Dental Center & Implants. We offer convenient solutions to make your visits seamless and stress-free.

Minimal Wait Times: Efficient scheduling to keep your visit timely and hassle-free.

Our commitment to convenience ensures that you can prioritize your dental health without disrupting your daily routine.

Danny Grayson Jr.
1 year ago
Very kind and professional people, I will definitely be back for all of my dental needs. Thanks guys!
A o
1 year ago
I had a few great experiences here but most recently I got a filling and it felt extremely rushed. The dentist was gone for a long time with other patients longer than usual and in general the service felt more rushed than previous fillings. They said to call if anything comes up or if I have any questions. As soon as the numbing wears off I feel a VERY sharp point on my filling that has been causing cuts under my tongue making eating or drinking or talking VERY painful so I have them a call a couple hours later. I think because there was a lot going on they didn’t put as much care into this appointment bc I have never had this issue but it had to be noticeable, it’s a jagged edge very painful. When I called to tell them a couple hours after my apt they tried to schedule me A WEEK away to fix it despite me telling them how painful it was and that it can’t wait. I told the receptionist please talk to the dentist because this is urgent if I can’t eat or talk because of a mistake they made. They never got back to me until 2-3 days later, and now they are still trying to schedule me two weeks after my original appointment time. If you care about your patients and their wellbeing, you should actually listen to them and make more effort to fix something that was caused in your office. If someone says they are in a lot of pain why make them wait 2weeks? Cruel and odd. When I called the receptionist was very dismissive despite me explaining all of this. The receptionists offer you appointments and when you pick a time that works for you they already gave up that time to someone else. As someone who has done scheduling in the medical field for several years, I understand it can be difficult, but don’t offer an appointment if you are not going to hold it. If you care about your patients you need to actually follow up with urgent matters if you are the one who caused it. Now I still have lacerations under my tongue and I still don’t have an appointment because the receptionists repeatedly have not listened to what I have said re scheduling. I am incredibly disappointed in the way this has been handled. Please do better :(
Edit: seeing your reply is completely unprofessional. I don’t care what “research” you did and apologizing for a patient’s “perception” of an experience is dismissive and frankly disrespectful and gross. You did not respond to emails or phone calls regarding any of these issues for ages, so I wanted to warn others. It’s embarrassing that you all think this is an appropriate response to this issue. Take the “Dental Emergency? Give us a call!” Off your website if you can’t actually help patients with emergency’s and especially ones that were caused in your office. So beyond disappointing. Think of a professional reply next time, come on.
Response from the owner
1 year ago
Hello - After doing a bit of research, it looks as we simply don't have the same type of record of events that you are describing in this review. Either way, we are truly sorry for your perception and confusion or any contribution to this occurrence. This accounting of events, in a public forum, is just simply not at all our "style" of business and our records show a much different story. We'd be happy to go over the records and timeline of events with someone in office.

I’ve been a patient here for about 8 years and it is time to part ways. My dental hygienist has been fantastic and deserves a raise.

Now with that out of the way here’s why I’ll no longer be making the drive. I had a filling they fixed last year come loose this week and I scheduled an 8:30 appointment to get it fixed.

Unfortunately Colorado weather has a tendency to cause problems so I managed to I showed up 13 minutes late after a 50 minute drive in the snow and I was told they just called me to reschedule (they didn’t). They took me back anyways, did an x-ray, and said they were just too busy to do anything at all about it. So they’d send me an estimate and reschedule.

I was surprised they didn’t offer to warranty the work at a minimum or even a “man that sucks here’s our apologies”. I’ve been making the drive because they always did good work but it seems they’re a just out of touch these days - felt like a spike in the wheel.

I decided to give my wife’s dentist a shot and I was in and out in 45 minutes including new patient paperwork, a fixed filling, and a nice personal conversation with the dentist.
